context.title: Executive Summary
context.content: JourneyLaw is a SaaS legal management platform designed to modernize and simplify the administration of legal cases. As the lead UX/UI Designer and front-end developer with over 15 years of experience, I led the digital transformation of this platform that revolutionizes how legal professionals manage their cases. The project showcases my ability to create intuitive digital experiences that solve complex challenges in the legal sector, implementing a scalable multi-tenant system with a modern, accessible interface that truly connects with users.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.content: Legal professionals were struggling with outdated tools that created daily frustrations: unnecessarily complex interfaces that wasted valuable time, fragmented workflows scattered across multiple applications, repetitive tasks that could—but weren't—being automated, limited scalability that hindered growth and client management, and inconsistent experiences across devices that disrupted productivity.

designSystem.title: Design System
designSystem.intro: At the heart of JourneyLaw's transformation is a comprehensive design system built around the concept of 'Warm Professionalism'. This system provides a foundation for a consistent, accessible, and scalable user experience.

solution.title: Value Proposition
solution.content: We developed a comprehensive solution with these key elements:
features: User-centered experience: Intuitive interface that minimizes the learning curve
Optimized workflows: Automation of repetitive processes for lawyers
Adaptive design: Works perfectly on desktop and mobile devices
Multi-tenant model: Secure data separation between different law firms
AI integration: Automatic document analysis and intelligent recommendations

steps.title: Discovery & Research
steps.content: I began with an intensive research phase to build genuine understanding: conducting user interviews to uncover key requirements like centralized case management, document automation, and AI-powered predictions, identifying differentiation opportunities through a simplified interface, AI integration, and mobile-first approach, and establishing clear KPIs to measure success.

steps.title: Information Architecture
steps.content: I completely redesigned the application structure to match users' mental models: developing an intuitive organization system that reflects how attorneys actually think about their cases and reducing the steps needed for common tasks, eliminating friction points.

steps.title: Design System
steps.content: I developed a modular design system that balanced consistency with flexibility, implementing a 'Warm Professionalism' philosophy with a carefully crafted color palette, typography system, and modular components.

steps.title: User Testing
steps.content: Multiple rounds of testing with 8 attorneys from different specialties ensured we were truly meeting user needs, with A/B testing to validate different approaches and data-driven iterations based on task success rates, average time per task, and System Usability Scale scores.

results.title: Results & Impact
results.conclusion: JourneyLaw demonstrates my ability to transform a complex domain into an intuitive, valuable digital experience. The project represents a perfect balance between user-centered design, robust technical implementation, and effective business strategy. As the lead UX/UI Designer and front-end developer on this project, I applied my years of experience to create a product that not only looks and works exceptionally well but generates real, measurable impact on legal professionals' daily work.

context.title: Project Context
context.content: Belcorp, a multinational cosmetics company, was looking to improve how their sales representatives managed their finances. The solution was a mobile wallet that simplified financial management and significantly enhanced the user experience.

challenge.title: Challenge
challenge.content: Sales representatives were facing difficulties managing customer payments, maintaining financial records, and accessing information about their earnings. This resulted in operational inefficiencies and frustration for the users.

solution.title: Solution
solution.content: We developed an intuitive mobile wallet with the following features:
features: Personalized financial dashboard
Real-time payment tracking
Simplified transaction management
Automatic payment notifications
Integration with local banking systems

steps.title: Research
steps.content: We conducted interviews with over 50 sales representatives to understand their financial needs, pain points, and current workflows.

steps.title: UX Design
steps.content: We created user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes based on research findings to ensure a smooth and user-centered experience.

steps.title: UI Design
steps.content: We developed a cohesive design system aligned with Belcorp's brand identity, using intuitive and accessible visual elements.

steps.title: Usability Testing
steps.content: We conducted multiple rounds of testing with actual users to refine the interface and address usability issues before launch.

results.title: Results
results.conclusion: This mobile wallet solution transformed financial management for Belcorp's sales representatives while driving significant improvements in company efficiency and profitability. The project demonstrates how strategic UX design can address complex business challenges while enhancing end-user quality of life through thoughtful digital experiences.

designSystem.title: Design System
designSystem.intro: The design system for Belcorp's Mobile Wallet was built on the pillars of 'Trust and Accessibility', ensuring that sales representatives could manage their finances with complete security.

context.title: Project Overview
context.content: A comprehensive financial security platform designed to transform how businesses manage factoring processes while ensuring maximum data protection. This solution creates a secure, intuitive environment for handling sensitive financial transactions and documents.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.content: Businesses needed a reliable way to manage factoring operations while protecting sensitive financial data from increasingly sophisticated security threats. Traditional solutions created friction between security and usability, often sacrificing one for the other.

subsections.title: Security Landscape Analysis
subsections.content: I conducted an extensive analysis of current financial security vulnerabilities and best practices, revealing critical patterns that informed our approach:
bullets: Threat Assessment - Identifying common attack vectors in financial platforms
Compliance Mapping - Analyzing regulatory requirements across multiple markets
User Behavior Studies - Understanding how security measures impact user workflows
Competitive Evaluation - Examining security implementations across the industry

subsections.title: User Research Highlights
subsections.content: In-depth conversations with experts to understand technical requirements and emerging threats. Comprehensive discussions with end-users to identify pain points in current security implementations. Detailed observation of real-world workflows to identify security friction points.

subsections.title: Key Research Insights
bullets: Users frequently bypass security measures they perceive as too cumbersome
Most security breaches occur through social engineering rather than technical vulnerabilities
Financial professionals need continuous visibility into security status without disruption
Trust indicators must be both visible and meaningful within the user interface

primaryPersona.name: Rafael Moreno
behaviors: Manages team access to financial systems
Balances operational efficiency with security protocols
painPoints: Complex security procedures slow down time-sensitive transactions
Difficulty tracking which team members have access to specific documents
Frustration with multiple authentication steps throughout the day
Uncertainty about whether security measures are actually effective

solution.title: Design Approach
solution.content: We developed a comprehensive security-focused design approach that balances protection with usability:
features: Security-First Architecture: Layered security model that protects data at rest, in transit, and during user interactions
Progressive Authentication: Contextual security system that adapts authentication requirements based on user behavior and risk
Trust-Building Interface: Clear security indicators and status visualizations that build user confidence
Seamless Recovery Mechanisms: Intuitive processes for handling security exceptions without compromising protection

steps.title: Intelligent Risk Detection
steps.content: Advanced algorithms identify unusual patterns and potential security threats without disrupting legitimate user activities.

steps.title: Document Vault
steps.content: Military-grade encryption for sensitive financial documents with granular access controls and comprehensive audit trails.

steps.title: Compliance Dashboard
steps.content: Real-time visibility into security status and compliance metrics with actionable notifications for potential issues.

steps.title: Secure Collaboration
steps.content: Protected communication channels and document sharing features that maintain security while enabling team collaboration.

results.title: Results & Impact

metrics.description: Security compliance across all client organizations
Increase in security feature adoption compared to industry average
Data breaches during the first year of implementation

results.conclusion: This project demonstrated that exceptional security and outstanding user experience are not mutually exclusive. By deeply understanding both security requirements and user workflows, we created a solution that protects sensitive financial data while enabling efficient operations. Future development will focus on expanding AI-powered threat detection capabilities and enhancing cross-platform security synchronization based on ongoing user feedback and emerging security threats.

designSystem.title: Design System
designSystem.intro: Security Bank's Factoring Module uses a robust and corporate visual language, focused on technical precision and operational efficiency.

context.title: Context
context.content: AI-powered UX research analysis platform that transforms hours of interviews into strategic insights in minutes, reducing synthesis time by 80%.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.content: "Analysis Paralysis" is the silent enemy of every product team. UX Researchers were spending more time transcribing and tagging hours of interviews than connecting dots and generating strategic insights. Qualitative richness was lost in endless spreadsheets or locked away in hour-long videos no one ever watched again. The challenge was to create a tool that didn't just transcribe, but "thought" like a senior researcher, automating synthesis without losing human empathy.

subsections.title: Discovery & Inspiration
subsections.content: I shadowed research teams in startups and corporations. I identified that the real pain wasn't data capture, but synthesis and traceability. Visual inspiration came from high-frequency financial dashboards: information density, absolute clarity, and smart alerts, but adapted to the language of human behavior.

subsections.title: Experience Definition
subsections.content: I designed a workflow that acts as a "copilot" for the researcher, structured in three levels of depth:
bullets: Intelligent Processing: Video/audio ingestion with real-time speaker diarization.
Augmented Synthesis: Automatic generation of "Golden Quotes", sentiment detection, and pain point prioritization classified by severity (Critical/High/Medium).
Structured Validation: Dynamic matrices where hypotheses are automatically cross-referenced with collected evidence, allowing assumptions to be validated or refuted in seconds.

designSystem.title: Design System
designSystem.intro: The IntelliResearch design system focuses on efficiency and clarity, allowing for fast synthesis of complex data.

solution.title: Technical Implementation
solution.content: I led the definition of a robust architecture to handle sensitive data and heavy processing:
features: Secure Streaming: Encrypted protocols for transmission and storage of confidential user material.
Advanced NLP: Integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) fine-tuned specifically for UX and Product terminology.
Real-time Feedback: Websockets to allow other team members to add notes or marks during a live interview.
Optimization: Lazy loading was implemented for massive transcripts and virtualized rendering for lists of thousands of data points, ensuring fluidity even in massive projects.

results.title: Transformative Results

metrics.description: Increase in reuse of old insights thanks to a centralized semantic search engine

results.conclusion: IntelliResearch transformed the researcher's role, freeing them from administrative tasks to empower their strategic capacity. We demonstrated that AI does not replace human intuition, but amplifies it, allowing us to listen to more users with greater depth and turn that empathy into better digital products.

context.title: Context
context.content: Radio Barrio Centenario is a community radio station that now broadcasts around the clock on its own digital platform: a mobile app for neighbors, a web player, and an Admin Console where the team manages shows, the weekly schedule, votes and announcements. I designed and built it end to end through Shape Creative Studio, my studio.

challenge.title: The challenge
challenge.content: A neighborhood radio runs on volunteers, a tight budget and an audience of all ages, including older adults. The challenge was to bring it to the phone without losing what makes it theirs: neighbors feeling that the station belongs to them. The app had to be as simple as turning on a radio, and the team needed to run the schedule without relying on a technician.

subsections.title: As simple as a radio
subsections.content: I started from who listens: neighbors of every age, many of them not used to apps. Large type, generous buttons and a main screen with one obvious action: listen.

subsections.title: Frictionless participation
subsections.content: The first version explored decentralized governance (DAO). In the live version, participation was simplified into three gestures any neighbor understands:
bullets: Reactions: "Like" songs and share your mood live.
Votes: neighborhood proposals with clear quorum and closing dates.
Announcements: neighborhood notices built into the menu, no extra screens.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.intro: A warm, legible visual language: the brand's pink and gold, light surfaces and generous type.

solution.title: One ecosystem, three pieces
solution.content: I designed and built the whole platform, from the user experience to the infrastructure.
features: Mobile app (React Native + Expo): 24/7 streaming with background audio, native controls, reactions, votes and schedule.
Admin Console (Next.js): the team manages the weekly schedule, shows, music blocks, votes and the broadcast engine, and follows the audience in real time.
Host workflow: hosts upload their recorded shows from the web and they go into the schedule.
Web player: the station can also be heard in the browser at radiobarriocentenario.cl.

results.title: Results

metrics.description: Audience growth with the digital signal
Continuous signal on app and web

results.conclusion: Radio Barrio Centenario went from concept to a platform in daily operation. The key lesson: in a community product, technology works when it disappears. What remains is the neighborhood radio, now in every neighbor's pocket.

context.title: Project Overview
context.content: Quiniela Engine is a private, automated platform for sports prediction pools among friends. It was born for the 2026 FIFA World Cup and evolved into an engine that adapts to different tournaments: the current edition is being prepared for the 2027 Rugby World Cup, with its pools, bonus points and knockout stage. It combines a fast web frontend, real results synced automatically and a daily AI bot on WhatsApp.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.content: Sports sweepstakes are traditionally managed via manual Excel spreadsheets, leading to update delays, calculation errors, and disputes among participants. They also lack immediate mobile interactivity. The challenge was to automate 100% of the game lifecycle (prediction submissions, official score sync, and ranking updates) and integrate a humorous, interactive social layer to maintain daily engagement without manual intervention.

screens.title: Rugby World Cup 2027 edition
screens.intro: The app dressed for the Rugby World Cup: same logic, new identity and the sport's own rules.

items.caption: Predictions by stage, with search and filters. Each match locks at kickoff.
items.alt: Match list with predicted scores: Australia 105, Hong Kong China 7

items.caption: Each pool's standings under rugby rules: 4 points per win plus bonus points.
items.alt: Pool A standings with Australia, Chile, Hong Kong China and New Zealand

items.title: Knockout stage

items.alt: Knockout stage with round of 16 fixtures

items.alt: Form to pick champion, runner-up and third place

solution.title: Value Proposition
solution.content: We developed an automated and immersive ecosystem with the following advantages:
features: Multi-tournament engine: the same codebase supports football and rugby, each with its own visual identity and rules (groups or pools, bonus points, knockout stages and a pre-tournament tiebreaker).
React 19 & Tailwind CSS v4 frontend: a fast interface optimized for entering predictions on a phone.
Automatic sync: Node.js scripts query results APIs and recalculate scores and points in Supabase.
Couch Coach (AI bot on WhatsApp): built with Evolution API and Groq, it analyzes the standings every night and roasts players in the group chat and by direct message.
Security and integrity: Supabase rules (RLS) lock predictions once each match kicks off.

steps.title: Rules & database modeling
steps.content: Defined the scoring system (exact score, winner, draw and stage) and database-level locks: each prediction closes at its match's kickoff, and the pre-tournament podium closes with the tournament's first match.

steps.title: Identity per tournament
steps.content: The 2026 FIFA edition started with a dark theme and moved to a light one with the World Cup palette. For rugby, components were reskinned by mapping the theme tokens to the RWC palette, without rewriting classes. Anton for scores and Noto Sans for the interface carry over to both.

steps.title: Automated Sync Workflows
steps.content: Configured cron scripts on macOS using launchd to regularly check the football API, update Supabase records, and recalculate user rankings.

steps.title: Sofa Coach Prompt Engineering
steps.content: Designed and tested the AI agent prompts for the 'Sofa Coach'. The bot reviews the database standings and drafts a hilarious daily roast message in the WhatsApp group.

results.title: Results from the 2026 FIFA World Cup edition

metrics.description: User disputes or manual data entry errors
Daily user interaction and engagement with the WhatsApp AI agent reports

results.conclusion: The 2026 FIFA World Cup edition showed that automating sports data and adding an AI bot on WhatsApp turns a niche prediction pool into a social experience with no management friction. The rugby edition reuses that engine and will go live for the 2027 World Cup.

context.title: Project Overview
context.content: AgileRadar is an internal intelligent bidding scouting and proposal drafting platform built for Shape. The system interfaces with Chile's public procurement portal (Mercado Público) to evaluate incoming bids and draft commercial proposals in minutes.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.content: Scouting public bids on government portals is a tedious process requiring managers to read through extensive PDF or Word documentation (typically 50-100 pages per bid). Evaluating technical fit is manual and consumes days, meaning high-value opportunities can easily be missed. The challenge was to centralize, automatically assess fit using AI, and generate technical-commercial proposal drafts.

solution.title: Value Proposition
solution.content: We designed an automated pre-qualification workflow combining natural language processing and real-time visualization:
features: Real-Time Kanban Board: Opportunities organized across pipeline stages, utilizing WebSockets for instant interface updates.
AI Fit-Scoring (Gemini 2.5 Flash): Automatic parsing of bid files to calculate compatibility (0-100 match score) with Shape's stack, along with a written justification.
Multi-Document consolidator: Drag-and-drop document upload (PDF/Word) that extracts text and compiles it into a structured reference context.
Technical Proposal Draft Engine: Instant generation of tailored proposals addressing critical Chilean bidding criteria in Markdown format.

steps.title: Mapping Shape's Core Stack
steps.content: Interfaced with Shape's team to define core criteria (UI/UX, React/TS, Design Systems) and structured them as system constraints for the Gemini scoring model.

steps.title: Kanban Pipeline Design
steps.content: Structured the board to display bids based on their compatibility match_score, automatically filtering out low-scoring bids to reduce manager cognitive fatigue.

steps.title: Consolidating Bidding Documents
steps.content: Created an intuitive sidebar drawer supporting multiple drag-and-drop document uploads, parsing them on-the-fly to construct the context package.

steps.title: Interactive Proposal UX
steps.content: Designed an interface that allows managers to read, refine, and edit proposal drafts generated by Gemini before downloading the final Markdown file.

results.title: Results & Business Impact

metrics.description: Reduction in bid scouting and pre-qualification time
Average time to generate a structured technical-commercial draft proposal
High-fit public bids missed or overlooked

results.conclusion: AgileRadar demonstrates how modern web applications built with LLMs can streamline complex B2G procurement pipelines, converting days of manual document parsing into minutes of intuitive, AI-assisted operations.

hero.alt: Chu, Chucao's mascot, reading a book surrounded by its moods

facts.label: Users
facts.value: Students aged 5 to 8 and their teachers

context.title: Context
context.content: Chucao (formerly LectorIA) is a B2B platform for schools that assesses oral reading fluency. Children read stories on a tablet alongside Chu, a Chilean chucao bird, while AI measures speed, accuracy and word-by-word errors right on the device. Teachers review the results in a web dashboard. I designed and built it through Shape Creative Studio, my studio.

challenge.title: The challenge
challenge.content: Measuring reading fluency today takes a teacher with a printed text and a stopwatch, one child at a time. It is slow, it depends on who assesses, and reading in front of an adult who is timing you makes children anxious. The challenge was to automate the measurement without losing pedagogical rigor, make it feel like a game rather than a test, and protect minors' voices under Chile's new data protection law (Ley 21.719).

screens.title: The tablet experience
screens.intro: A full reading, start to finish, through the student's eyes.

items.alt: Preparation modal with Chu and the All set to read button

items.title: Reading at their own pace

items.alt: Reading screen with Chu listening and the I'm done reading button

items.alt: Friendly notice asking to read the whole story, with a button to start again

items.caption: When it ends: stars, words achieved and a day streak. Hard words become practice with a concrete hint.
items.alt: Adventure completed modal with Chu, three stars, 24 of 26 words achieved and one word to practice

adminScreens.title: Teacher platform
adminScreens.intro: The web panel where teachers follow their class's progress and review every reading. Fictional demo data.

items.title: Dashboard
items.caption: Assessments completed, active students, average WCPM and class accuracy, with fluency progress over time.
items.alt: Teacher dashboard with indicators, a fluency trend chart and latest assessments

items.title: Students
items.caption: Each student with their level, average WCPM and the status of their permissions: data, cloud audio or audio kept on the tablet.
items.alt: Student cards with Lexile level, average WCPM and consent status

items.title: Parental consent
items.caption: The teacher records data processing consent and cloud audio consent separately, referencing the signed document.
items.alt: Consent modal with checkboxes for data processing and cloud audio

items.title: Assessment detail
items.caption: Every word classified as correct, omitted, substituted or inserted, the audio at different speeds and the grade's pedagogical benchmark.
items.alt: Assessment detail with the text colored word by word, an audio player and fluency metrics

subsections.title: Two users, two experiences
subsections.content: The product has two sides with opposite needs:
bullets: Student: tablet, one task per screen, large text and no signs of being assessed.
Teacher: a high-density dashboard to review assessments in batches, listen to the audio and export reports.
School leadership: aggregated indicators by class and school for improvement plans.

subsections.title: Chu, the heart of the experience
subsections.content: I replaced the first version's generic owl with Chu, a chucao, a bird from the Chilean forest. Chu has 10 emotional states (greets, thinks, listens, celebrates, encourages after a mistake) inspired by Duolingo's positive reinforcement. There are no error sounds or visible timers: time is measured, but the child never sees it.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.intro: Forest green, terracotta and warm anti-glare surfaces, with Literata for reading.

solution.title: The solution
solution.content: A dual platform with the AI running inside the tablet:
features: Edge AI: Whisper (whisper.rn) transcribes speech on the tablet itself with a ~31 MB quantized model; after the first download it works offline.
Word-by-word analysis: each word is classified as correct, omitted, substituted or inserted, and the app computes reading speed (WCPM) and the Ministry of Education level.
Teacher dashboard: batch review, a player that syncs the audio with the word breakdown at 0.75x, 1x or 1.25x, and PDF reports for parents.
Offline-first: assessments are stored on the tablet and synced when the connection returns, built for classrooms with unreliable internet.

steps.title: Consent first
steps.content: Without parental consent recorded by the teacher, the student does not appear on the tablet and the server rejects their assessments.

steps.title: The voice stays on the tablet
steps.content: Transcription happens on the device. Audio is only uploaded with explicit consent and is deleted automatically after 90 days.

steps.title: Minimal data
steps.content: Only the initial of the student's last name is stored. Each school is isolated from the others at the database level.

steps.title: Documented legal framework
steps.content: Impact assessment (DPIA), privacy policy, consent form and processing agreement under Ley 21.719: the school is the controller and Chucao the processor.

results.title: Status and next steps
results.conclusion: Chucao is a working MVP. The next step is validating it against human assessors with an agreement protocol defined before any data is collected: 20 readings per grade from 1st to 3rd, comparing speed, accuracy and word-by-word errors.

context.title: Project Overview
context.content: Grant Thornton Chile required a unified and modernized ecosystem for its internal tax compliance tools, consolidated into a single secure portal named BusinessTools. As Lead UX/UI Designer, the challenge was to design a robust corporate design system in React, TypeScript, and CSS Modules, fully documented in Storybook, serving as a consistent foundation across three independent repositories (tax-portal-frontend, portalgt-backend, and celery-k8s).

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.content: The platform processes heavy financial data density: complex tax grids (annual F22, monthly F29, additional F50), real-time scraping bot monitors, and company group assignments. The primary UX hurdle was to present dense tax details cleanly and accessibly following Apple's HIG (Human Interface Guidelines). Furthermore, the portal required a strict role-based access control system (RBAC) and alternative flat styling configurations for exporting reports to PDF (via WeasyPrint) and emails (Mailing) without modern CSS support.

solution.title: Value Proposition
solution.content: We engineered an interactive, atomic component library tailored for corporate compliance and legibility:
features: Atomic Design Architecture: Structured components strictly into Atoms, Molecules, Organisms, and interactive demo Pages in Storybook.
Adaptive Apple HIG Aesthetic: Floating cards on grouped backdrops (#F2F2F7), clean 16px corner radii, subtle shadows, and backdrop blur effects (glassmorphism).
Specialized UI Export Modes: Dedicated Storybook configuration that discards border radii, drop shadows, and scale transforms to guarantee clean render outputs in PDFs and enterprise email clients.
Embedded Access Control (RBAC): Built-in control components like 'PermissionGuard' and reactive authorization hooks to dynamically hide/show menu items and operations based on user privileges.

steps.title: Mapping Financial Workflows
steps.content: Interfaced with accountants and tax analysts to organize annual income, monthly sales tax, and supplementary tax filings into a logical information hierarchy.

steps.title: Storybook Component Library
steps.content: Developed and tested components (buttons, grids, inputs, OCR upload areas) with live controls in Storybook to guarantee consistent behavior and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility.

steps.title: Optimizing for Limited CSS Engines
steps.content: Investigated and developed flat UI variations specifically adapted for the Python WeasyPrint engine and enterprise Outlook email rendering.

steps.title: Role-Based Navigation and Skeletons
steps.content: Designed dynamic menu states based on user roles and custom skeletons to reduce perceived wait times during complex report generation.

results.title: Results & Business Impact

metrics.description: Brand consistency across all three repositories using the shared package
Compliance in typographic contrast and interactive component accessibility
Layout issues when exporting to PDF (WeasyPrint) or sending emails

results.conclusion: The BusinessTools Design System demonstrates that technical rigor in React/TS component architecture, combined with a premium Apple HIG native aesthetic, can elevate complex corporate utilities into highly efficient, secure, and user-friendly web portals.
